data.desc: Celularity Inc. (Nasdaq: CELU) is a longevity-focused regenerative and cellular medicine company developing and manufacturing allogeneic and autologous cell therapies and biomaterials. Celularity's regenerative longevity vision centers on advancing technologies intended to address aging and age-related conditions and extend healthspan. Its purpose-built facility in Florham Park, New Jersey supports manufacturing, research and biobanking activities. Celularity also pursues contract development and manufacturing opportunities that apply its infrastructure and technical expertise to third-party programs.
